responsibilities: Build and maintain modular, well-tested dbt models on Microsoft Fabric.
Optimise existing transformations for performance, cost and maintainability.
Own data models end to end — from source through to the semantic layer.
Define and document the metrics that matter across the group, so that one metric has one definition everywhere.
Set modelling standards, naming conventions and testing practice — and hold the line on them.
Build reusable structures so that new questions do not each require a new pipeline.
Develop Power BI datasets and reports that stakeholders genuinely use.
Go past reporting into analysis: identify what the numbers mean and what should change as a result.
Work directly with commercial, supply chain and finance teams to frame the questions worth answering.
Explain analytical work to non-technical stakeholders clearly and without condescension.
Raise data literacy across the group and make self-service genuinely usable rather than nominally available.
Build testing, monitoring and documentation into the pipeline as standard.
Treat data quality as a feature of the product, not a cleanup task.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build testing, monitoring and documentation into the pipeline as standard.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals ("well-tested dbt models", "testing practice", "monitoring", "real test coverage") far outweigh the single pragmatism cue, so rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Work directly with commercial, supply chain and finance teams to frame the questions worth answering.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Wholesale analytics informing business decisions with no regulatory or financial-reporting framing, so moderate.

evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A small existing data team (a data scientist and a data engineer) and an existing dbt-on-Fabric stack being extended, so mid.
evidence.jd_authorship: Set modelling standards, naming conventions and testing practice — and hold the line on them.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name the stack, the semantic layer and concrete first-year outcomes, so a Tuesday morning is clear.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Work directly with commercial, supply chain and finance teams
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Commercial, supply chain and finance are named with equal weight, alongside group-wide data literacy, so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: Define and document the metrics that matter across the group
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role defines the metric framework and sets modelling standards ("Define", "Set", "Own"), so strategic.

evidence.testing_framing_explanation: The candidate owns testing practice and builds testing and monitoring into the pipeline, so responsibility.

evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Stakeholder trust appears in the role summary and quality language recurs ("Protect the foundation", "reports that stakeholders trust"), so high.
